_doc: Which CLI answers each BAML function (BAML renders the prompt and parses the reply; the CLI only answers). Roles: Sonnet = main agent and glance judge; Haiku 5.5 = fast cheap reviews/parsing (keep inputs small, well under 100K tokens); no Opus per build. provider: claude (claude -p) | codex (codex exec). fallback is tried if the first fails.
